name: Search and scan

entryPoints.label: via the bottom bar
entryPoints.control: Search and scan (the middle button, a magnifier)

flow: type part of a tag or pen
tap the scan icon in the field
the reader reads a tag: she is ticked

controls.does: turns the field into the scan bar

states: Empty field: only the hint (this screen)
Typed: results grouped by unit (Search · results)
Pigs ticked, scanning stopped (Stopped · the ticks kept)

elements.name: Search field
elements.shows: A full-height white page (the status bar turns white with it). The field is pinned and focused: the search icon, the typed text, ✕ once something is typed, the scan icon and Cancel.
elements.rule: Cancel returns to Home and keeps the ticks for the next visit; the scan icon turns the field into the scan bar.

copy: (raw) Type part of an ear tag or a pen, or scan a tag. Searches every unit.
rules: Owner, 2026-10-22: Home searches and scans on one page. The middle button of the bottom bar opens it (a magnifier, no word); the field searches, and its scan icon turns it into the scan bar, as Choose pigs does. Each read ticks the pig; the ticks stay through searching and Stop.

Owner decision 2026-10-12: search and scan are different jobs (type, tap one; hands-free reads). Owner, 2026-10-22: a multi-select place ticks each pig as she is read (Search and scan, features/find-pig). One card per unit under a plain "Unit 7" heading, this unit first (owner, 2026-10-20).
Replaces Home's two ways in (Toolbox › Find a pig or pen, and the Scan ear tags page from the bottom bar's Scan).
notes.purpose: Reach any pig of the section by her ear tag or pen, from the bottom bar's middle button: type to search, or tap the scan icon to scan. The page as it opens: nothing typed, nothing ticked.

controls.does: ticks her for Actions; the count and Actions appear in the footer
opens her pig record (the Inspection pig record, embedded over the device); its Back returns here with the text and the ticks kept

states: Matches in one unit or several: one card per unit
Pigs already ticked keep their ticks

elements.name: Results
elements.shows: One tinted card per unit under its plain heading. The tick box, the tag over her pen, and her marked condition on the right when she has one (as To treat and Monitoring draw it), then the door to her record. The typed part of the tag (or the pen) is bold ink, the rest muted, as Find marks it.
elements.logic: Tags that start with the typed text come first, then tags that contain it, then a pen that matches. The unit the worker is in leads. A pig ticked here joins the list, so she is still there once the field is cleared.

elements.shows: One quiet line quoting what was typed.
elements.rule: The field keeps focus and ✕ is shown, so the worker corrects the number at once.

controls.does: ends scanning; the search field returns

elements.name: Scan bar
elements.shows: Lookup's scan bar in the field's place, at the field's height, in the scan hue: "Scanning" / "Scan to tick pigs", and Stop. Cancel stays beside it.
elements.rule: Stop returns the search field with the ticks kept. The bar is the only scanning status (owner, 2026-10-20).

elements.name: Scan bar, waiting
elements.shows: "Waiting for reader" / "Make sure Reader 1 is on" (the paired reader's name), and Stop; the line under it says scanning starts as soon as the reader connects.
elements.rule: It turns to Scanning by itself when the reader connects; there is nothing to tap. As Choose pigs.

elements.name: Scan list
elements.shows: The tick box, the tag over her pen, and her marked condition on the right when she has one (as To treat and Monitoring draw it), then the door to her record.
elements.logic: Newest read first within its unit; a repeat read adds no second row and lights hers again.

elements.name: Selection bar
elements.shows: The plain count ("3 pigs selected") and the primary Actions.
elements.rule: The count is plain text, not a button; the ticks in the list are the selection.

states: "2 pigs selected" and Actions in the footer; ticking nothing removes the footer

elements.name: Unticked row
elements.shows: Her row stays where it was, unticked.
elements.rule: Unticking never removes her from the list; ticking her again counts her again.

elements.name: Ticked list
elements.shows: The list as scanning left it, under the empty field. Typing narrows to the results; clearing brings the list back.
elements.rule: Leaving the page keeps the list for the next visit.
